tone_gauge_v3.code:
def tone_gauge_v3(text):
    warm = ['love', 'thank', 'proud', 'happy', 'warm', 'glad', 'wonder', 'together', 'safe', 'kind']
    cold = ['urgent', 'fail', 'broken', 'panic', 'danger', 'crisis', 'angry', 'afraid', 'deadline', 'stuck']
    t = str(text).lower()
    w = sum(1 for x in warm if x in t)
    c = sum(1 for x in cold if x in t)
    return 'warm' if w > c else ('tense' if c > w else 'neutral')
tone_gauge_v3.description: Reads the emotional tone of a message as warm, tense or neutral.
tone_gauge_v3.test_input: Thank you, I am so proud and happy
